relations.text_en: Williams is a partner in the Laurel Mountain Midstream joint venture for gathering and processing assets

source.label: EQT 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Laurel Mountain Midstream, LLC (LMM) is a midstream company formed as a joint venture among the Company, Williams Companies Inc. and certain other energy companies for the purpose of owning and operating gathering and processing assets.
